name: dsh-auth-cookie-sweep
description: Expire stale dsh-auth-* browser-session cookies, rescue a DeepSeek Harness profile already locked out by a 431 (budget grows with the largest jar seen, with no ceiling), and show the login-cookie jar live at /auth-cookie-sweep.

scripts.test: node --test test/purge.test.mjs test/integration.test.mjs test/header-budget.test.mjs test/recovery.test.mjs test/jar-health.test.mjs test/health-page.test.mjs test/health-routes.test.mjs test/budget-state.test.mjs test/package-manifest.test.mjs
